verdict.rationale: Medusa documents its own built-in customization framework for building custom commerce applications, plus Admin Injection Zones, Medusa UI, and an official CLI. That covers the core 'build extensions' part of the story with first-party tooling. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced official SDK, a CLI documented as scaffolding apps or plugins, any documented review or distribution path (plugin marketplace or publishing process), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom apps and extensions with official SDKs, scaffolding tooling, and a documented review/distribution path

citations.quote: Medusa is a commerce platform with a built-in framework for customization that allows you to build custom commerce applications without reinventing core commerce logic.
Extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow.
